entities.name: Taborax
entities.description: A notorious demon from Zendikar who has gathered the largest cult among demons worshipped after the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Plane where Taborax originates and where people turned to demon worship after the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings whose rise and fall left Zendikar's inhabitants fearing future threats.

entities.name: Cult of Taborax
entities.description: The largest cult of demon worshippers on Zendikar, who believe Taborax alone can shield them from the Eldrazi.

events.summary: After the fall of the Eldrazi, Zendikari despair drives many to worship demons; Taborax gathers the largest cult.
events.quote: Taborax has succeeded in gathering the largest cult

events.summary: Taborax grants fragments of power to faithful followers while demanding far greater tribute and loyalty.
events.quote: he ensures that the tribute and loyalty he demands in return far exceed what he bestows

relations.note: He is the demon the cult worships.
relations.quote: Taborax has succeeded in gathering the largest cult
Taborax is a notorious demon originating from the plane of Zendikar
